Upsert Dataset Record.description: Creates or updates one record in a server dataset, e.g. a beneficiary or facility pre-load list.

Bulk Upload Dataset Records.description: Uploads many rows to a dataset as CSV, merging on a key field.

Upsert Dataset.description: Creates a server dataset, or updates its settings if it already exists.

Fetch New Submissions.description: Fetches only submissions received since the last run, using a rolling cursor.

Fetch Approved Submissions.description: Fetches only submissions that passed review, so unreviewed data never reaches downstream systems.

Fetch Submissions As CSV.description: Fetches form submissions as a CSV string, e.g. to drop into a data warehouse or file share.
Fetch Submissions As CSV.code:
// Fetch submissions in long-format CSV.
fetchSubmissions('nutrition_screening', { format: 'csv' });

List Dataset Records.description: Lists records in a server dataset, following pagination.

List Datasets.description: Lists the server datasets on the SurveyCTO server.
List Datasets.code:
// List all server datasets.
list('datasets', { limit: 100 });

List Users.description: Lists the users on the SurveyCTO server, e.g. to audit enumerator accounts.
List Users.code:
// List server users (v2 API).
list('users', { limit: 100 });
